pages.text: Standard box: 2 × 5 slots, 10 total.$(br2)Extended box: 2 × 6 slots, 12 total.$(br2)Wide box: 4 × 8 slots, 32 total, with closer lateral spacing.$(br2)Choose exactly one box. The same wheel, shaft, cover and canopy items work across sizes; fitted geometry adapts to the box.

Craft an extended box from a standard box, then a wide box from an extended box. Each upgrade retains the input box’s wood; auxiliary wood materials may differ.$(br2)Upgrading happens in crafting, not by using an installed box. Unload and recover the box first, craft the upgrade, then rebuild.
